🚨 **Delivery Pressure Points**
**5 outlets** are showing delivery-related complaints, with **Gwalbhog | Gwalia Sweets And Restaurant** (2.3★) and **Gwalia Sweets Pvt Ltd** (2.4★) facing the most serious issues.

⏱️ **What Customers Are Experiencing**
Guests reported delays stretching 15-30 minutes beyond promised times, missing items upon arrival, and food arriving cold or spilled due to rushed packaging. One customer mentioned a 45-minute wait when 30 minutes was promised, while another's order never arrived at all.

✅ **Recommended Action**
Audit prep-to-dispatch workflows at the two lowest-rated outlets. Compare their kitchen timing and packaging protocols with top performers like **Gwalia Purani Delhi** (4.5★) to identify where the breakdown happens.
